svg.title: GameStop system — UML use case diagram
svg.desc: UML use case diagram for the GameStop integrated management system showing 6 actors — Customer, Store Clerk, Store Manager, IT System, Regulatory Agency, and Supplier — and 15 use cases inside the system boundary, with include, extend, and generalization relationships.
